questions.question: RAN5#109 미팅의 TDoc 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber:'RAN5#109'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title ORDER BY t.tdocNumber LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 TDoc의 상세 정보는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber:'R5-255500'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, c.companyName

questions.question: 특정 CR의 상세는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec) WITH DISTINCT c ORDER BY c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 1 OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, c.title AS title, sp.specNumber AS specNumber

questions.question: TDoc 수가 가장 많은 미팅 Top 5는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber, count(t) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Samsung의 TDoc 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName:'Samsung'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber ORDER BY t.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Rel-18 TDoc 수는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName:'Rel-18'}) RETURN count(t) AS cnt

questions.question: 38.533을 수정하는 CR 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber:'38.533'}) RETURN cr.tdocNumber ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: WorkItem별 TDoc 분포 Top 5는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem) RETURN wi.workItemCode, count(t) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Agenda별 TDoc 분포 Top 10은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) RETURN ai.agendaNumber, count(t) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Type별 TDoc 분포는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc) RETURN t.type, count(t) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Company별 CR 기여도 Top 10은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, count(cr) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 TDoc의 revision 체인은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:IS_REVISION_OF]->(:Tdoc) WITH DISTINCT t ORDER BY t.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH p=(t)-[:IS_REVISION_OF*1..3]->(prev:Tdoc) RETURN t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, prev.tdocNumber AS prevTdoc, length(p) AS hops ORDER BY hops ASC, prevTdoc DESC

questions.question: LS 방향 분석 (sentTo)?
questions.cypher: MATCH (ls:LS) OPTIONAL MATCH (ls)-[:SENT_TO]->(wg:WorkingGroup) RETURN ls.tdocNumber, ls.direction, collect(wg.wgName) AS sentTo LIMIT 5

questions.question: 전체 노드/관계 통계는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n) RETURN labels(n)[0] AS label, count(n) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

questions.question: 미팅별 TDoc 커버리지는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting) WITH m OPTIONAL MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m) WITH m, count(t) AS tdocs RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber, tdocs ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: SUBMITTED_BY 커버리지는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN count(t) AS total, count(c) AS withCompany

questions.question: Release별 TDoc 분포는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release) RETURN r.releaseName, count(t) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Spec별 CR 수 Top 10은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) RETURN sp.specNumber, count(cr) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: RAN5#109 미팅 TDoc 수는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber:'RAN5#109'}) RETURN count(t) AS cnt

questions.question: 전체 Meeting 수는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (m:Meeting) RETURN count(m) AS cnt

questions.question: CR 비율은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc) WITH count(t) AS total MATCH (cr:CR) RETURN total, count(cr) AS crs

questions.question: LS 수는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (ls:LS) RETURN count(ls) AS cnt

questions.question: Contact 수는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Contact) RETURN count(c) AS cnt

questions.question: AgendaItem 수는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (ai:AgendaItem) RETURN count(ai) AS cnt

questions.question: WorkItem 수는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (wi:WorkItem) RETURN count(wi) AS cnt
